chunks: "I seek refuge in the Merciful from you, if you fear Him," she said.
ai.seo_question: What did Maryam say when the angel appeared to her?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Maryam’s (peace be upon her) spiritual vigilance and purity as she seeks refuge in the Merciful from the angel Jibril, acknowledging his divine status yet distinguishing him from God. The phrase 'if you are pious' reflects a nuanced theological stance where her piety serves as the basis for her respectful yet cautious interaction with the celestial messenger. This moment is pivotal in establishing her unique status among women in Islamic tradition, emphasizing her direct connection to divine will.
